key_methods.role: Centralized gesture arbitration runtime delivering hardware touches to active recognizer graphs.
Analyzes translation vs pinch vs rotation vectors to disambiguate concurrent gestures.
Returns dominant kinematic component (translation, scale, rotation).
Distinguishes continuous drag gestures from ballistic fling gestures using velocity thresholds.
Timer-based touch delay manager holding touch delivery until gesture failure or recognition.
Cancels active touch delay timer when a competing gesture fails.

UIGestureRecognizer.role: Abstract root base class for all UIKit gesture recognizers.

ivars.name: isa
ivars.description: Objective-C runtime class pointer

ivars.name: _targets
ivars.description: Target-action invocation descriptors

ivars.name: _gestureEnvironment
ivars.description: Back-pointer to window gesture environment coordinator

ivars.name: _view
ivars.description: Attached hosting UIView

ivars.name: _state
ivars.description: Current state machine state (0=Possible, 1=Began, 2=Changed, 3=Ended, 4=Cancelled, 5=Failed)

ivars.name: _flags
ivars.description: Bitfield: cancelsTouchesInView, delaysTouchesBegan, delaysTouchesEnded, etc.

ivars.name: _delegate
ivars.description: Delegate for dynamic arbitration (simultaneous, shouldBegin, shouldReceiveTouch)

ivars.name: _failureRequirements
ivars.description: Set of recognizers that must enter Failed state before this recognizer can begin

ivars.name: _failureDependents
ivars.description: Set of recognizers waiting for this recognizer to fail before they can begin

ivars.name: _allowedTouchTypes
ivars.description: Bitmask / array of permitted UITouchType values (direct, pencil, indirect)

ivars.name: _allowedPressTypes
ivars.description: Permitted UIPressType values

ivars.name: _customHysteresis
ivars.description: Custom touch slop override distance in points

methods.role: Core state machine mutator enforcing valid state transitions and triggering failure dependent cascade.
Registers a directed dependency edge in the arbitration DAG.
Evaluates whether recognition cancels a competing recognizer.
Evaluates whether recognition is blocked by a competing recognizer.
Resets internal state, touches, and hysteresis to Possible state.

UIPanGestureRecognizer.role: Continuous drag recognizer accumulating 2D displacement and multi-sample velocity.

ivars.name: _startLocation
ivars.description: Location where touch contact began

ivars.name: _currentLocation
ivars.description: Latest touch position in view coordinates

ivars.name: _translation
ivars.description: Accumulated delta translation relative to slop boundary

ivars.name: _sampleRingBuffer
ivars.description: Ring buffer of 8 timestamped points for least-squares velocity estimation

ivars.name: _sampleCount
ivars.description: Number of valid samples in ring buffer

ivars.name: _sampleIndex
ivars.description: Head insertion index in ring buffer

ivars.name: _directionalLockEnabled
ivars.description: Restricts movement to single axis (horizontal or vertical)

ivars.name: _lockedAxis
ivars.description: Active locked axis (0=None, 1=Horizontal, 2=Vertical)

ivars.name: _customHysteresis
ivars.description: Touch slop threshold (Finger=10pt, Pencil=4pt, Trackpad=2pt, Ballistic=0pt)

ivars.name: _hysteresisOffset
ivars.description: Subtracted from translation to prevent jump upon slop crossing

ivars.name: _minimumNumberOfTouches
ivars.description: Minimum touches required to begin pan (default 1)

ivars.name: _maximumNumberOfTouches
ivars.description: Maximum touches allowed (default UINT_MAX)

methods.role: Accumulates touch displacement, tests slop threshold, and triggers Possible -> Began -> Changed transitions.
Returns 2D translation relative to touch start minus hysteresis offset.
Calculates instantaneous velocity vector via OLS regression over ring buffer.

UIScreenEdgePanGestureRecognizer.role: Pan recognizer constrained to screen boundary activation insets.

ivars.name: _edges
ivars.description: Active edges mask (UIRectEdgeLeft, UIRectEdgeRight, UIRectEdgeTop, UIRectEdgeBottom)

ivars.name: _edgeRegionSize
ivars.description: Depth of screen edge activation strip in points (typically 15-20pt)

methods.role: Tests whether initial touch location falls strictly within specified edge inset rectangle.

UISwipeGestureRecognizer.role: Discrete gesture recognizing rapid directional flicks.

ivars.name: _direction
ivars.description: Permitted swipe direction bitmask (Right=1, Left=2, Up=4, Down=8)

ivars.name: _numberOfTouchesRequired
ivars.description: Required concurrent touches (default 1)

ivars.name: _maximumDuration
ivars.description: Maximum elapsed time before swipe recognition fails (~250ms)

ivars.name: _minimumPrimaryMovement
ivars.description: Minimum distance in primary swipe direction (typically 20-30pt)

ivars.name: _maximumSecondaryMovement
ivars.description: Maximum allowable perpendicular movement tolerance (~15pt)

methods.role: Validates directional trajectory, velocity threshold, and perpendicular deviation constraints.

UITapGestureRecognizer.role: Discrete recognizer detecting single or multi-tap touch down/up cycles.

ivars.name: _numberOfTapsRequired
ivars.description: Required successive tap count (1=single tap, 2=double tap)

ivars.name: _numberOfTouchesRequired
ivars.description: Required simultaneous touch contacts (default 1)

ivars.name: _allowableMovement
ivars.description: Maximum distance touch contact may move before tap fails (typically 10pt)

ivars.name: _maximumIntervalBetweenSuccessiveTaps
ivars.description: Maximum inter-tap delay window (~350ms)

ivars.name: _maximumTapDuration
ivars.description: Maximum contact duration for a single tap (~250ms)

methods.role: Verifies contact duration and allowable movement bounds to transition to Ended (Recognized).

UILongPressGestureRecognizer.role: Continuous gesture detecting stationary touch contact exceeding minimum duration.

ivars.name: _numberOfTapsRequired
ivars.description: Preceding tap count before press (default 0)

ivars.name: _numberOfTouchesRequired
ivars.description: Required simultaneous touches (default 1)

ivars.name: _minimumPressDuration
ivars.description: Threshold duration before Began state fires (default 0.500s / 500ms)

ivars.name: _allowableMovement
ivars.description: Allowable movement radius during press hold (default 10.0pt)

ivars.name: _delay
ivars.description: Internal timer scheduling transition to Began state

methods.role: Schedules press duration timer and captures anchor touch coordinate.

UIPinchGestureRecognizer.role: Continuous two-touch gesture measuring relative distance changes (scale).

ivars.name: _scale
ivars.description: Current scale factor relative to initial touch separation

ivars.name: _velocity
ivars.description: Rate of scale change per second

ivars.name: _initialTouchDistance
ivars.description: Euclidean distance between two touches at gesture start

methods.role: Computes ratio of current distance to initial distance, transitioning to Began / Changed.

UIRotationGestureRecognizer.role: Continuous two-touch gesture measuring angular rotation in radians.

ivars.name: _rotation
ivars.description: Angular rotation in radians relative to initial orientation

ivars.name: _velocity
ivars.description: Angular velocity in radians per second

ivars.name: _initialTouchAngle
ivars.description: Angle between two touch points at gesture start

methods.role: Computes relative angular delta between touches, transitioning to Began / Changed.

UIGestureRecognizerArena.role: Private collision resolution arena managing competing gesture recognizers.

ivars.name: _gestureEnvironment
ivars.description: Associated gesture environment

ivars.name: _activeRecognizers
ivars.description: Currently active competing recognizers in arena

ivars.name: _delayedTouchesQueue
ivars.description: Queue of touches delayed pending arbitration resolution

methods.role: Gates gesture activation based on view hierarchy Z-order and failure requirement graphs.
Routes incoming hardware touches to eligible recognizer subgraphs.

_UIGestureEnvironment.role: Per-window centralized gesture coordinator driving event fan-out and arbitration.

ivars.name: _window
ivars.description: Hosting UIWindow instance

ivars.name: _registeredRecognizers
ivars.description: All gesture recognizers attached to views in this window

ivars.name: _dependencyGraph
ivars.description: DAG of failure requirements and exclusion rules

ivars.name: _systemGestureGate
ivars.description: System gesture gate coordinator

methods.role: Central event loop delivering UITouchesEvent to active recognizer subgraphs.
Inserts a directed dependency edge into the failure requirement DAG.

_UISystemGestureGate.role: Pass-through gate holding touches until system-level edge gestures recognize or fail.

ivars.name: _activeSystemGestures
ivars.description: Set of active system-level recognizers (Back, NC, CC, Reachability)

ivars.name: _timeoutTimer
ivars.description: Timeout timer releasing delayed touches if system gestures stall

methods.role: Cancels userland touches when a system edge gesture recognizes.
Releases held touches to userland views when system edge gesture fails.
